messages:
Mira Chen: Heads-up — NimbusRetail agreed to a short profile and a 20-min customer interview for a launch post + webinar mention. They want the quote cleared by legal before publish. timeline = 2 weeks if we can move fast.
Samir Patel: Awesome. Who's on interview? customer PM + Head of ML, right?
Mira Chen: Yeah — Lina (PM) and Marco (Head of ML). Prefer async q&a or 20m Zoom? they prefer Zoom.
Priya Nair: I can run the interview and draft the story. I'll prepare a 6-question guide and send it by EOD. Can we get brand assets and logo rights?
Mira Chen: @Priya good call. Nimbus legal said logo use is fine but we need an explicit written quote approval. Jordan, can you confirm what wording we need from them?
Jordan Lee (Legal): Please get this from the customer: (1) explicit quote text they approve; (2) permission to use company name & logo in promotional materials; (3) confirmation there is no confidential data in the quote. We also prefer a simple approval email thread we can store.
Samir Patel: I'll draft the quote after the interview. Quick draft to run by Nimbus: "Redwood reduced median inference latency by ~45% and allowed us to reallocate infra budget to product" — does that look ok?
Jordan Lee (Legal): Don't include specific %s unless Nimbus authorizes numbers. If they gave the figure in the interview that's fine, but we need them to sign off.
Priya Nair: Noted. I'll push for permission to include the latency stat in writing. Also asking for logo (SVG) and short bio for Lina.
Alex Voss: For the launch plan: blog + 2 social posts + an entry in the upcoming benchmark narrative doc. Also slot a 10-min mention in the product webinar on Friday two weeks from now. Does that timeline fit?
Mira Chen: Two weeks is tight but doable if legal approval doesn't drag. Priya — can you aim to have the interview and first draft in 4 business days?
Priya Nair: Yes — interviewing Lina/Marco Wednesday morning, draft by Thursday close. Will add the quote pick-list and a section for legal to sign off.
Samir Patel: Once Priya posts the draft I'll do a quick polish and add the short pull-quote for social.
Jordan Lee (Legal): When you have the draft, @Jordan Lee (Legal) will require a PDF of the final quote and an approval email from an authorized Nimbus contact. Please cc legal@redwood.ai in the approval thread.
MarketingOpsBot: Calendar invite created: Nimbus interview — Wed 10:00am PT — Zoom link attached. Reminder set 24h before.
Mira Chen: Great. Last ask — can we get a short customer quote (1-2 sentences) that marketing can use in the webinar slide deck? If Nimbus approves, we'll lock down slide copy and submit to design.
Priya Nair: I'll request the 1-2 sentence quote in the interview and push for approval in the same email.
Alex Voss: If we get the approval by end of week 1, design can turn creative in week 2 and we remain on schedule for the webinar callout. :thumbsup:
Mira Chen: Perfect. I'll track in Asana and ping if legal needs anything specific. Thanks everyone — moving to action items.
